design: All five architectures and both seeds. One-to-one group matching maximizes normalized projector overlap using dictionaries only. Evaluate decoded group-vector magnitude correlation across512 H859 natural occurrences. No activation-based matching. Postfit supervised task-axis overlap is diagnostic only.
groups: Scalar atoms; native8-coordinate blocks;8-member shared groups. Shared activity is own gate times norm of union-coded coordinates decoded through group atoms. Overlapping group activities are not an additive attribution. No norm calibration: tests native geometry/routing, not calibrated output quality.
controls: Eight random signed ambient-coordinate permutations of seed2 dictionary, preserving all within-dictionary geometry; recompute optimal matches each time. Activities are unchanged under these isometries. This is an orientation control, not a null for every training bias. Self/permutation/sign/within-block-rotation algebra checks.
scope: Confirmation documents reused from H859; task axes discovery-supervised. Two seeds insufficient for population stability. No causal or semantic claim from agreement alone.
